_comment: Copy this file to config.json and edit it. config.json is gitignored so everyone keeps their own local copy without stepping on teammates. The four `_model_N` blocks below are the exact four models proj1a used -- same four for proj1b, so the D5 model comparison carries across both projects.
name: claude-pro-cli

_model_1_claude_pro_subscription.name: claude-pro-cli
_model_1_claude_pro_subscription._setup: one-time: `claude login` (do NOT set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in your environment, or the CLI uses that instead of your subscription)
_model_1_claude_pro_subscription._note: the only config that supports conversation chaining and file_access

_model_2_chatgpt_plus_subscription.name: chatgpt-plus-codex-cli
_model_2_chatgpt_plus_subscription._setup: one-time: `npm install -g @openai/codex`, then `codex login` (sign in with your ChatGPT account)
_model_2_chatgpt_plus_subscription._note: codex exec is not chained by this harness -- set chain:false or every prompt errors
_model_2_chatgpt_plus_subscription._web: codex_search adds `--search` for web access. VERIFY with `codex exec --help` on your machine; if the flag isn't there, set codex_search to false and the rows log web=unavailable.

_model_3_gemini_PREFERRED_web_capable.name: gemini-grounded-api
_model_3_gemini_PREFERRED_web_capable._setup: free-tier key from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey, then set GOOGLE_API_KEY in your environment (never in this file)
_model_3_gemini_PREFERRED_web_capable._web: grounding:true enables Google Search grounding. This is the recommended Gemini config for proj1b -- the agy CLI below cannot search at all.

_model_3_alt_gemini_via_antigravity_NO_W.name: gemini-antigravity-cli
_model_3_alt_gemini_via_antigravity_NO_W._setup: one-time: install Google Antigravity (https://antigravity.google), launch it once to sign in with your Google account
_model_3_alt_gemini_via_antigravity_NO_W._web: CANNOT search: --mode plan blocks all tool use, and that same flag is the only thing stopping agy writing files, so we don't drop it. Rows log web=unavailable. Check `agy --help` for a search flag -- if one exists, wire it into providers.call_cli and this becomes usable for the market prompts.

_model_4_local_ollama.name: qwen2.5-coder-14b-local
_model_4_local_ollama._note: the 'fourth running locally (Ollama-class)' model proj1b asks for. chain:false is REQUIRED -- providers.py raises for any non-cli provider when a session is passed.
_model_4_local_ollama._web: CANNOT search, ever -- no tools, no machine to run them on. It still answers every prompt; rows just log web=unavailable, so its market claims are recall rather than evidence. That contrast is D5 material, not a defect.
